messages_orig.content: I have a baby who’s a little over six months old, and he’s otherwise healthy. He’s been exclusively on formula so far, but I’m ready to introduce solid foods. What I want to do is figure out the right age to start and also get some ideas about what kinds of foods are best to begin with. If possible, please include one or two options that are easy to feed him when we’re out running errands.
